captions.detailed: A professional-scale camera speedlight flash unit, featuring a tall rectangular battery body, a central neck, and a wide rectangular flash head. The body has a rear control panel with a small screen and six raised prismatic buttons surrounding it. The upper head is mounted on a wide cradle, exposing the support geometry, and features a light gray front diffuser lens. The neck swivels continuously on a vertical axis relative to the body, and the flash head tilts on a horizontal hinge at the top of the neck.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a professional camera speedlight with a rectangular battery body, a rear control panel with buttons and a screen, a central neck, and a tilting rectangular flash head. The neck should connect to the body with a continuous vertical swivel joint, and the flash head should connect to the neck with a horizontal tilt joint.
captions.factory: The speedlight is constructed using three main parts: a base body, a neck, and a flash head. The base body is created from a rounded Box, with a rear control panel consisting of a thin screen Box and six small prismatic button Boxes. The neck link is built from a vertical Cylinder, a thin disk, and a rectangular support block. The head is made from a rounded Box, with a front-facing light gray Box representing the flash lens, and two side hinge cylinders. Two joints are defined: a continuous swivel joint between the base and neck, and a revolute tilt joint between the neck and the head.
